args.summary:
Global FE model built and verified for the 3-span cast-in-place continuous box girder bridge (35 + 45 + 35 m).

Modeling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, elastic beam-column elements, linear elastic analysis (MR-01).
- Structural system: continuous_on_piers (MR-05) — cast-in-place continuous box on two pier lines with given twin 1.8 m round column geometry (support lines numbered 0–3, spans 1–3).
- Girder section (single-cell cast box, cast_box, C50): integrated A = 6.712 m², I = 4.4982 m⁴, Ec = 37000 MPa (measured, INPUT override of code default), γ = 26.0 kN/m³, w = 174.512 kN/m, m = 17.789 t/m. Dead load = girder self-weight only (MR-07).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge = 1.0 MPa default): Abutment 0 and Abutment 3 and Pier 2 use PTFE sliding bearings (vertical spring, longitudinal free, Kh = 0); Pier 1 uses fixed plain elastomeric bearings (vertical spring, longitudinal spring, Kh = 10909 kN/m). Kv values: Ab0/Ab3 = 3.142e6 kN/m (400×500, 5 layers), Pier1 = 8.029e6 kN/m (600×700, 7 layers), Pier2 = 7.175e6 kN/m (550×650, 6 layers). 2 bearings per line, paralleled (MR-03, MR-04, JTG 3362-8.7).
- Piers (C40, Ec = 32500 MPa): twin 1.8 m columns merged; Pier1 H = 20 m, Pier2 H = 27 m; A = 5.0894 m², I = 1.0306 m⁴ (MR-06).
- Live load Highway Class I: 3 design lanes (one-way, W = 11.5 m), ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 330/350/330 kN per span, impact factor μ = 0.1806 from fundamental frequency f1 = 3.037 Hz (JTG D60-4.3.1/4.3.2).

Key results:
- First three vertical frequencies: 3.037, 4.653, 5.398 Hz.
- Self-weight support reactions: 2241 / 7800 / 7779 / 2249 kN (sum ≈ total girder weight).
- Self-weight midspan moments: 12493 / 15853 / 12632 kN·m; support moments: −28459 / −28181 kN·m.
- Governing lane-load moment: max positive 11474 kN·m (span 2), max negative −9093 kN·m.

All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed. No unresolved issues.
